issues.failure_explanation: Lemma 5.5 claims that every $v_h \in \cV_h$ can be decomposed into an exact sum $v_h = \sum_{\ell=1}^N v_{h,\ell}$ with $v_{h,\ell} \in \cV_\ell = \cV_h \cap H^1_0(\Omega_\ell)$. The proof defines $v_{h,\ell} := \cI_h((1 - \psi_\ell)\widetilde{v}_{h,\ell})$ where $\widetilde{v}_{h,\ell} = \Pi_h^{L^2}(\chi_\ell v_h)$. While $\sum_{\ell=1}^N \widetilde{v}_{h,\ell} = v_h$, the functions $\widetilde{v}_{h,\ell}$ are not supported in $\Omega_\ell$. Truncating each component with $1 - \psi_\ell$ introduces a non-zero residual $r_h = \sum_{\ell=1}^N \cI_h(\psi_\ell \widetilde{v}_{h,\ell})$, so $\sum_{\ell=1}^N v_{h,\ell} = v_h - r_h \neq v_h$ (for example, on internal subdomain boundaries where all $\psi_\ell = 1$, every $v_{h,\ell}$ vanishes identically, whereas $v_h$ does not). Lemma 5.6 (lem:key_Garding) subsequently relies on the exact equality $w_h = \sum_{\ell=1}^N w_{h,\ell}$ to expand $\Re a(w_h, w_h) = \sum_{\ell=1}^N \Re a(Q_\ell w_h, w_{h,\ell})$, which is invalid without accounting for $r_h$.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Restate Lemma 5.5 as an approximate stable splitting $v_h = \sum_{\ell=1}^N v_{h,\ell} + r_h$. Complete the bound on the residual $\|r_h\|_{H^1_k(\Omega)} \leq C E \|v_h\|_{L^2(\Omega)}$ across all of $\Omega$ using the exponential decay of the $L^2$-orthogonal projector and an inverse estimate on elements away from $\supp \chi_\ell$. In Lemma 5.6, expand $\Re a(w_h, w_h) = \sum_{\ell=1}^N \Re a(Q_\ell w_h, w_{h,\ell}) + \Re a(w_h, r_h)$, bound $|a(w_h, r_h)| \leq \epsilon \|w_h\|_{H^1_k}^2 + C \epsilon^{-1} E^2 \|w_h\|_{L^2}^2$, and absorb it into the existing $E^2 \|w_h\|_{L^2}^2$ term in (5.9).
issues.overall_effect: The exact splitting identity in Lemma 5.5 fails, making the initial equality in the proof of Lemma 5.6 invalid. Through Lemma 5.6, the lower bound on the field of values in Theorem 3.1 and the resulting GMRES iteration bounds in Corollaries 3.3, 3.4, and 3.5, as well as the $hp$-convergence result in Theorem 7.1, are formally unestablished as written.
issues.title: Failure of exact stable splitting in Lemma 5.5 due to truncation of L^2 projection
issues.why_classification: A complete resolution requires a contained nontrivial argument (bounding the $H^1_k$ norm of the residual tail of the $L^2$ projection globally across $\Omega$ and propagating the error term through the Gårding estimate in Lemma 5.6). Once repaired, no global proof architecture needs replacement and all substantive theorems, rates, and GMRES iteration guarantees survive intact.
